# Most-Followed Person On TikTok: Top 11! 🔴

Most-Followed Person On TikTok: Top 11! 🔴

With an exploding rising popularity (and on the brink of getting banned), TikTok has been a sensational platform from the beginning.

It offered a unique twist to browsing social media and devised an algorithm that kept people on the platform for as long as possible.

Like with every other social media platform, celebrities, and creators flocked to TikTok to increase their popularity.

In this article, we will discover who is the most-followed person on TikTok and how they earned the title.

But before we get there, let's also go through the other top 10 accounts with the most followers on TikTok.

We'll be seeing creators whose niches range from dance challenges and comedy sketches to makeup tutorials and food.

Let's start!

### 11. The Rock (@therock) | 69.3M Followers

No matter which platform you're on, you will see this celebrity among the most-followed accounts. So it's no surprise that The Rock is also one of the most-followed TikTokers, with over 69.3 million followers.

You can expect to find reels related to his workout session, behind-the-scenes shooting for his action movies, and attending high-profile events. Some of his more popular content revolves around his family and daily life.

The Rock does not shy away from posting TikToks showing his daughters applying princess makeup on him.

### 10. Burak Özdemir (@cznburak) | 69.7M Followers

If you're looking to add some mouth-watering Turkish cuisine to your TikTok feed, look no further than Burak Özdemir, who has amassed an incredible 69.7 million followers on the platform.

His mesmerizing and entertaining videos have made him one of the most popular chefs on TikTok. Burak's dedication to Turkish cuisine has earned him a loyal fanbase both on and off social media.With his infectious personality and engaging content, Burak has become a global influencer and has collaborated with several high-profile brands, such as Pepsi and Samsung.

In 2022, Burak's hospitalization caused distress to his millions of fans throughout the world. Fortunately for everybody, he came back stronger than ever.

### 9. TikTok (@tiktok) | 71M Followers

Considering your reading an article on TikTok, it shouldn't be surprising that the company itself is also on the list.

With 71 million followers, we think TikTok's popularity is well deserved since it took the internet by storm with its innovative yet addictive interface.

From DIY hacks and lip-syncing videos to travel and educational, TikTok has it all. Not to mention how the app has over a billion active users worldwide, it has become a hub for creative content creators and influencers who have gained massive followings through their engaging and entertaining videos.

Not only this but thousands of businesses are profiting every day from their presence on TikTok. With such a high virality score, you never know when TikTok will turn something into an overnight sensation.

Let's just hope it doesn't get banned...

### 1. Khabane Lame (@khaby.lame) | 155.8M Followers

We talked about the Queen of TikTok. Now let's talk about the King of TikTok, Khabane Lame.

After his ( Fortunate? ) layoff during the pandemic in 2020, Khabane took to TikTok, where he initially posted himself dancing and playing video games.

But what got him fame was his signature hand gesture as he proceeded to mock complicated life hacks, which struck a chord with his audience.

He now sits contently on the throne as the most-followed person on TikTok with a staggering 155.8 million followers. Moreover, almost a million people search him every month on Google!

With how social media works these days, making anything go viral in a matter of few hours, you never know who will be the most-followed person on TikTok by the end of the year.

Maybe Charli D'Amelio will take her title back? Maybe Khabane lame will witness exploding growth once again.

Or maybe someone not even on this list will be the next TikTok star.

Only time will tell.

As TikTok continues to evolve and shape the future of social media, we can expect to see even more incredible talent emerge and capture our hearts and attention.

## Who has the most followers on TikTok right now?

Khaby Lame has the most followers on TikTok right now.\ Here’s the full top 10.

| Account | Country | Followers |
 --- 
| 1. Khaby Lame | Senegal/Italy | 162.5 million |
| 2. Charli D’Amelio | United States | 159.3 million |
| 3. MrBeast | United States | 129.6 million |
| 4. TikTok | China | 95 million |
| 5. Bella Poarch | Philippines/United States | 91.9 million |
| 6. Addison Rae | United States | 87.9 million |

| 8. FIFA World Cup | Switzerland | 86.6 million |
| 9. Zach King | United States | 86.4 million |
| 10. Kimberly Loaiza | Mexico | 83.5 million |

### 1. Khaby Lame – 162.5 million followers

Khaby Lame, a silent-comedy content creator who only started in 2022, is the most-followed TikTok account. On the surface, Lame’s work feels very familiar. He made his name reacting to “life hack” videos, poking fun at them with over-the-top expressions.But his content’s simplicity, its tried-and-tested format, is what makes it so appealing. It’s familiar, relatable, and something that’s been around since the early days of cinema. Think of Buster Keaton and Charlie Chaplin — during the silent-film era, they entertained millions of people through physical comedy. Lame does a similar thing, just a hundred years down the line.

### 2. Charli D’Amelio – 159.3 million followers

Charli D’Amelio is a social media star and dancer who held the most-followed TikTok title until Lame overtook her.

D’Amelio’s fame is spread across a ton of touchpoints: Disney and Nickelodeon TV shows, a cosmetics company, a clothing line, a music career, Broadway roles, and more. Much of her content focuses on her daily routine, dance choreography, and various memes and TikTok trends; it’s a pretty perfect balance.

### 3. MrBeast – 129.6 million followers

MrBeast is everywhere in 2026. Not satisfied with running the most-subscribed YouTube channel, Jimmy Donaldson ranks as the third-most-followed TikTok account, too.

MrBeast’s content is larger than life, offering people the chance to win money, experience unbelievable moments, and break records. He leaves his full-length challenges to YouTube, but posts enough teasers, outtakes, and memery to make an impact on TikTok.

### 4. TikTok – 95 million followers

Perhaps it seems strange that TikTok itself is on this list, but it makes sense. Instagram is the most-followed Instagram account, for example. TikTok’s official account leans heavily on updates and promotional videos, blending user-generated content with professionally shot footage.

### 5. Bella Poarch – 91.9 million followers

Bella Poarch may be the fifth-most-followed person on TikTok, but she’s #1 in another category: she created the platform’s most-liked video of all time. The US Navy veteran started creating content back in 2020, went viral, and hasn’t looked back since.

Poarch has built a healthy bank of lip-syncing, gaming, and musical content over the past few years, broadening her scope beyond social media. Her varied content appeals to lovers of nerd culture and more general, trend-hungry viewers, balancing both audiences with ease.

### 6. Addison Rae – 87.9 million followers

Addison Rae started in a similar way to “TikTok-famous” folks like Charli D’Amelio, also gaining traction with dance videos. Since hurtling into the spotlight back in 2019, Rae’s taken up podcasting, singing, acting, and more.

Money loves meeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee comment to claim

Willie Salim is the opposite of “no good deed goes unpunished.” His success comes from buying huge amounts of food or goods, then gifting it to those who need it. It’s feel-good content that checks a similar box as MrBeast, but without the multimillion-dollar challenges.
